mapper.select: INSERT INTO tb_id_sequence ( generator_key, scope_key_1, scope_key_2, last_issued_value ) VALUES ( #{generatorKey}, #{scopeKey1}, #{scopeKey2}, 1 ) ON CONFLICT (generator_key, scope_key_1, scope_key_2) DO UPDATE SET last_issued_value = tb_id_sequence.last_issued_value + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING last_issued_value
mapper.update: INSERT INTO tb_id_sequence ( generator_key, scope_key_1, scope_key_2, last_issued_value ) VALUES ( #{generatorKey}, #{scopeKey1}, #{scopeKey2}, #{minimumValue} ) ON CONFLICT (generator_key, scope_key_1, scope_key_2) DO UPDATE SET last_issued_value = GREATEST( tb_id_sequence.last_issued_value, EXCLUDED.last_issued_value ), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
